mapper.select: SELECT * FROM course_review WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM course_review WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM course_review WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_review WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM course_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_review (course_id, user_id, rating, content, is_anonymous, reward_granted, status, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{isAnonymous}, #{rewardGranted}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDeleted})
mapper.select: SELECT r.review_id, r.course_id, CASE WHEN r.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE r.user_id END AS user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.status, r.create_time, r.update_time, CASE WHEN r.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.nickname END AS user_name, CASE WHEN r.is_anonymous = 1 THEN NULL ELSE u.avatar_url END AS avatar_url FROM course_review r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.user_id = u.user_id WHERE r.course_id = #{courseId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE course_review SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE course_review SET reward_granted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND reward_granted = 0
UPDATE course_review SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS rating_count FROM course_review WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT r.review_id, r.course_id, c.course_name, c.course_code, u.real_name AS teacher_name, r.rating, r.content, r.is_anonymous, r.create_time FROM course_review r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN user u ON c.teacher_id = u.user_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
